_schema_notes.purpose: Schema template only, not experiment results. Null scores remain PENDING. Populate from actual saved evaluations; do not make up entries to satisfy counts.
_schema_notes.paths: All paths are relative to hw2/. Output files listed under samples/results are checked when packaging.
_schema_notes.metric: A metric can be a finite scalar or an object with mean, std, optional ci95, and n; never report synthetic probes as music-model results.
_schema_notes.configurations: At least three distinct basic_a.configurations; each needs id, parameters, n=20, metrics H4/GS, and 20 actual samples. Each sample has output_midi, output_wav (selected set), bars=32, seed. Optional submission_samples chooses exactly twenty from a larger evaluated run.
_schema_notes.basic_b: Exactly nine results, three configurations per prompt ID 001/002/003. Fields: prompt_id, configuration_id, bars=32, prompt_bars=8, new_bars=24, output_midi, output_wav, is_best. Exactly one best per prompt. selection_reason/analysis must distinguish measured diagnostics from actual listening impressions.
_schema_notes.bonus: If attempted=true, exactly ten IDs001..010 with bars=16 and finite CA/OA_P/OA_V/OA_D/OA_IOI. Never read prompt PIANO GT during inference.
_schema_notes.additional_experiments: Each item has name, method, headers, rows (max6 for a single slide), analysis, discussion, limitations; split larger tables into multiple items. Only include performed comparisons. No hypothetical results.
_schema_notes.checkpoints: Each reproducibility.checkpoints item is {path, sha256, trained_from_scratch:true}; tokenizer_files lists only vocabulary/configuration text. Checkpoint provenance must come from the actual training log.
_schema_notes.status: Use complete only when measured work is complete. Substantive missing checks remain DRAFT. An explicit user-selected GitHub host retains a separate unverified hosting warning; it is not represented as TA-approved cloud-drive equivalence.

research_questions: How does sampling temperature change musical diversity, rhythmic consistency, density and repetition?
Do later checkpoints improve generation quality as well as next-token prediction?
How does available context affect continuation structure at a controlled training budget?
Can melody-conditioned generation preserve the complete supplied melody and produce useful accompaniment?

data.source: Official course POP909/training only; three basic prompts and ten bonus prompts are excluded from training.
data.diagnostic_split: PENDING: record actual song-level split and seed, followed by any all-896-song final fit.
data.final_fit: PENDING: confirm every official training song participates; final all-song fit has no held-out validation estimate.
data.beat_grid: Supplied beat/downbeat annotations define bars; MIDI time-signature metadata is not treated as authoritative.

real_baseline.name: POP909 reference under matching representation and bar grid

basic_a.baseline_protocol: PENDING: record actual window selection and shared quantization settings.

basic_b.method: PENDING: actual prefix-conditioning, stopping and exact-note preservation checks.

reproducibility.submission_inventory: 20 basic-a MIDI/WAV pairs; all 9 basic-b pairs; 10 bonus pairs if complete.

ai_disclosure: Codex assisted with code, experiment execution, aggregation, analysis and English drafting. Numerical results must be derived from saved actual experiment outputs. Unperformed comparisons and listening tests are not claimed.
